page.layout: One printed page, one text column. At the top, the page number and running head. The first lines are a continuation in black letter and roman. Then headings and paragraphs in the column. No marginal notes. The bottom has a stray mark, not text.

main_text.p: weichbild. Sub Rubric. Gros eltern sind näher Erben zunemmen / dann schwester oder brüder. Vide Schneidcvvinum[?].
main_text.head: Sequentes Regulae de parentum naturalium successione sunt observandae.
main_text.p: Pater naturalis tantum, solus existens, filio naturali extincto, succedit in duabus unciis, hoc est, sexta parte hereditatis. Authen. licet. §. ab intestato. C. de naturalibus liber.

Mater vero & alij ascendentes lineae maternae, eidem filio defuncto æque succedere possunt, ac si ex legitimo matrimonio natus esset. §. final. inst. de SC. Tertyllian. & l. si spuriis. ff. unde cognati.
main_text.head: Sequentes Regulae de successione legitimorum parentum tantum sunt observandae.
main_text.p: Facta adoptione ab extraneo, filio defuncto, pater naturalis patri adoptivo in ejus hæreditatis succes-sione præfertur: sed defuncto adoptato ab ascendente, adoptivus pater exclufo, naturali, eidem succedit. l. cum in adoptivis. §. sed ne articulum. C. de adoptionibus.
Pater arrogante solo superstite post obitum filij arrogati, tota ejus hæreditas ad eundem solum devolvitur: sed si vixerit adhuc arrogati pater natura-lis,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Schneidcvvinum" (the letter after "Schneid" may be e; marked [?]). The top line of black letter is read as printed. The ornamental mark after "Prima Regula" and "Secunda Regula" in the heading was read as a flourish and not transcribed. A stray mark (a dash and a small stroke) lies at the bottom centre of the page and is not text. The left edge of the scan shows the dark background and page edge, which are omitted. The "|" in "ejus|hæreditatis" is read as a line-break mark and not kept.
